title: Code Autopsy Result
description: Canonical, versioned result envelope emitted by every engine command (system of record). Byte-identical inputs always produce byte-identical result_digest values.

schema_version.description: Pinned contract version. Breaking changes require a new version plus changelog and compat test.

run.description: Command execution metadata for this report.

run_id.description: Deterministic run identifier derived from command and snapshot.

command.description: Engine subcommand that produced this report (baseline, diff, impact, verify).

analyzer_version.description: Engine version that computed the result; part of snapshot identity.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration in milliseconds. Telemetry only, never hashed into digests.

result_digest.description: BLAKE3 digest of the canonical report; mirrors the root result_digest.

snapshots.description: Repository states compared or analyzed, in before-then-after order.

snapshot_id.description: BLAKE3 identity over file set, config hash, and analyzer version. No timestamps.

revision.description: Revision label supplied at scan time (informational only).

config_hash.description: BLAKE3 hash of the normalized engine configuration.

file_set_digest.description: BLAKE3 digest over the sorted file manifest (path, content hash, language).

change_set.description: Semantic delta between before and after snapshots (present for diff).

file_deltas.description: Added, deleted, modified, and unambiguous rename file deltas.

contract_deltas.description: Contract Added/Removed/Modified deltas with is_breaking flags.

impact.description: Bounded transitive impact closure for the query seeds (present for impact).

query.description: Seed symbols, direction, and traversal profile as executed.

impacted_entities.description: Complete impacted identity set in lexical order (evidence completeness).

ranked_top.description: Reviewer shortlist: top-k entities by shortest-path distance. Presentation only.

total_impacted.description: Full impacted count; equals impacted_entities length.

paths.description: Ranked shortest paths (length, then lexical) from seeds to impacted entities.

traversal_profile.description: Profile name that governed traversal (e.g. cli-impact, cli-impact-callers).

truncated.description: True when depth or budget caps cut the traversal; the frontier is partial.

findings.description: Invariant and contract verdicts. Unknown is reported explicitly and never renders as pass.

id.description: Stable finding identifier (rule id plus finding suffix).

rule_id.description: Invariant rule that produced this finding.

status.description: Verdict. Unknown means undecidable under current coverage, never approval.

entities.description: Implicated symbol or file identities (empty when none).

coverage.description: Coverage state under which the verdict was reached.

evidence.description: Verifiable receipts linking each finding to locations, paths, and digests.

rule_id.description: Invariant rule that produced the finding.

locations.description: Exact source locations backing the finding.

symbol_id.description: Owning stable symbol identity, when known.

evidence_digest.description: BLAKE3 digest over the canonical receipt; verify via integrity check.

coverage.description: Honest semantic coverage for this run (FR-014, FR-030).

state.description: Overall coverage: verified (fully resolved), partial (reflection/proxy/generated), unsupported, or unknown (dynamic constructs present).

unsupported_constructs.description: Dynamic construct kinds encountered (e.g. Eval, DynamicImport).

files_scanned.description: Number of files included in the snapshot.

result_digest.description: BLAKE3 digest over the canonical report JSON. Byte-identical across reruns on identical inputs.
